manage.title: History
manage.subtitle: What the daemon can show about runs it has finished — and what it cannot say.
manage.reconnecting: The daemon is reconnecting — the history view asks nothing until the connection is current.
manage.reconnectingHint: No rows are held over from the last answer: an answer that never arrived is not a fact.
manage.offline: The daemon is not reachable — nothing can be shown until it is talking again.

vocabulary.failed: The daemon’s vocabulary could not be read — until it answers, this screen names no lanes and offers no grouping.

scope.title: Scope
scope.subtitle: One scope, one way: the daemon is asked with its own filter words, never with a sweep of this screen’s.
scope.rootHint: Pick a root, or leave the span whole — the screen never names a component you did not pick.
scope.rootPicked: The roots below are the ones the daemon lists today; an empty answer offers only the whole span.
scope.laneHint: The lane words are the daemon’s, served by history.vocabulary — this screen types none of them.
scope.laneWaiting: No lanes yet — nothing can be chosen until history.vocabulary answers.
scope.sinceHint: An optional lower bound, sent only when you type one.

coverage.title: Coverage
coverage.cannotSay: This view cannot say what {count} archived entries contain — they are neither shown nor absent.
coverage.cannotSayHint: The ids named below are the ones the daemon could point at; the count is the whole of them, and the list is capped by the daemon’s own limit.
coverage.failed: The coverage read was refused — the rows below stand unqualified until it answers.
coverage.loading: Asking the daemon what it covers…
coverage.none: No coverage answer has arrived yet — what follows is unqualified.

rows.title: Rows
rows.subtitle: The rows the daemon grouped and filtered, in its answer’s own order.
rows.noStatement: The daemon answered with no rows and sent no statement — this screen writes none of its own.

export.label: Export
export.personOnly: Export is a person’s door — it is disabled while you are read-only or the daemon is not answering.

drilldown.title: The entry, through its own door
drilldown.loading: Asking the daemon for this entry…
drilldown.nothing: The answer carried no transcript and no files — there is nothing to show, and nothing is invented.
